name: Gloves of the Battlemage
body:
Price 5,000 gp; Slot hands; CL 5th; Weight 1 lb.; Aura faint transmutation

DESCRIPTION

These hardened leather gloves protect the hands from stray blows, yet allow the fingers to remain fully flexible.

Whenever the wearer of the gloves of the battlemage casts a spell with a range of touch, they may move up to 10 feet as part of the touch attack made to cast the spell. This movement provokes attacks of opportunity as normal.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,500 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells expeditious retreat
